hook: A planar Brownian path's sausage has about T/(r^2 (log T)^2) holes on average.
summary: The expected number of holes in a thickened planar Brownian path is pinned to order T/(r^2(log T)^2) for long times. The proof prices the ways near-critical pockets can form along the path's two independent arms, and also separates which holes matter at leading order. It is a pure-math estimate of order, so exact constants are not determined.
title: The expected number of holes of the planar Wiener sausage
